# The `iterator_facade_base` Class Template Reference

## Description {#details}

<p>CRTP base class which implements the entire standard iterator facade in terms of a minimal subset of the interface.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">Use</a> this when it is reasonable to implement most of the iterator functionality in terms of a core subset. If you need special behavior or there are performance implications for this, you may want to override the relevant members instead.</p>


<p>Note, one abstraction that this does <em>not</em> provide is implementing subtraction in terms of addition by negating the difference. Negation isn't always information preserving, and I can see very reasonable iterator designs where this doesn't work well. It doesn't really force much added boilerplate anyways.</p>


<p>Another abstraction that this doesn't provide is implementing increment in terms of addition of one. These aren't equivalent for all iterator categories, and respecting that adds a lot of complexity for little gain.</p>


<p>Iterators are expected to have const rules analogous to pointers, with a single, const-qualified <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a2366b4a30c90d2207626fb717dfb778d">operator*()</a> that returns ReferenceT. This matches the second and third pointers in the following example:</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">int</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a066e2a31a13d6520e52ae1944f194662">Value</a>;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">{ </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">int</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> *<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/support/md5-cpp/#ac0eafdc9ee161b71e7af98af736952fd">I</a> = &amp;<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a066e2a31a13d6520e52ae1944f194662">Value</a>; }             </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">// ReferenceT 'int&amp;'</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">{ </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">int</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> *</span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/support/md5-cpp/#ac0eafdc9ee161b71e7af98af736952fd">I</a> = &amp;<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a066e2a31a13d6520e52ae1944f194662">Value</a>; }       </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">// ReferenceT 'int&amp;'; const</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">{ </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">int</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> *<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/support/md5-cpp/#ac0eafdc9ee161b71e7af98af736952fd">I</a> = &amp;<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a066e2a31a13d6520e52ae1944f194662">Value</a>; }       </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">// ReferenceT 'const int&amp;'</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">{ </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">int</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> *</span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/support/md5-cpp/#ac0eafdc9ee161b71e7af98af736952fd">I</a> = &amp;<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a066e2a31a13d6520e52ae1944f194662">Value</a>; } </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">// ReferenceT 'const int&amp;'; const</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>If an iterator facade returns a handle to its own state, then T (and PointerT and ReferenceT) should usually be const-qualified. Otherwise, if clients are expected to modify the handle itself, the field can be declared mutable or use const_cast.</p>


<p>Classes wishing to use <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/iterator-facade-base">iterator_facade_base</a></span> should implement the following methods:</p>


<p>Forward Iterators: (All of the following methods)</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>DerivedT &amp;operator=(const DerivedT &amp;R);</li>
<li>bool operator==(const DerivedT &amp;R) const;</li>
<li>T &amp;operator*() const;</li>
<li>DerivedT &amp;<a href="#a10f99fd6afbddb5694dc277415dd143a">operator++()</a>;</li>
</ul>

<p>Bidirectional Iterators: (All methods of forward iterators, plus the following)</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>DerivedT &amp;<a href="#a2b1add08071860fb4ce9f8b24b35271a">operator--()</a>;</li>
</ul>

<p>Random-access Iterators: (All methods of bidirectional iterators excluding the following)</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>DerivedT &amp;<a href="#a10f99fd6afbddb5694dc277415dd143a">operator++()</a>;</li>
<li>DerivedT &amp;<a href="#a2b1add08071860fb4ce9f8b24b35271a">operator--()</a>; (and plus the following)</li>
<li>bool operator&lt;(const DerivedT &amp;RHS) const;</li>
<li>DifferenceTypeT operator-(const DerivedT &amp;R) const;</li>
<li>DerivedT &amp;operator+=(DifferenceTypeT N);</li>
<li>DerivedT &amp;operator-=(DifferenceTypeT N);</li>
</ul>

<p>Definition at line 80 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/iterator-h">iterator.h</a>.</p>
